_meta: G6 fragment (owner: ELEV). CONTRACTS_G6: rules.g6_elevation (section 7, D23/D24). New ids/keys only; numbers are PROVISIONAL balance fixtures.

g6_elevation._doc: Levels 0 valley, 1 plain (default), 2 hill, 3 ridge. Per level of advantage: sight +sight_per_level tiles, weapon range x range_mult_per_level, damage taken from a lower attacker x defence_mult_per_level. Ramp cells: speed x ramp_speed_mult. Old-format HILL tiles load as hill_level.

gen._doc: MapGen height noise for generated / editor maps (MapGen.add_height_noise).
